impact.text: Full theft of a user’s settlement assets after they obtain the required self‑allowance permit.

precondition_sources.text: A validator has issued the owner→owner self-allowance permit required for normal withdrawals for the victim owner.
The caller of withdraw/redeem is an address other than the owner.

intent_sources.text: withdraw and redeem must require that msg.sender is the owner or has allowance, as the NatSpec states.
Only the owner (or an approved delegate) may cause withdraw/redeem of that owner's shares.
